t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes will come in the same pairs, one of the gnomes will gain you more mushrooms whilst one will be fewer, however in the game these can swap over at any time

vb_textbox.text: Find the gnome from the the sets of gnomes Red with yellow Pink with green purple with blue and orange with brown that offers the most reward and stick to it, I found red, green, brown and blue were best but you may find other that are better, they may change through the game. Also use one hand to do the s and k keys and one for the space bar, use your body to help decide which side to press which will follow down your finger. Relax and enjoy.
